questions.question: The trade activity that involves buying and selling of goods and services within the boundaries of a single country is called ______.
The trader who buys goods in large quantities directly from the manufacturer and sells in smaller quantities to retailers is the ______.
A petty trader who moves from one place to another carrying goods on his head or on a bicycle to sell to people is a ______.
The final link or person in the chain of distribution of goods and services is the ______.
Which of the following activities is classified as an aid to trade?
The aid to trade that helps businessmen store goods safely until they are needed by customers is ______.
The primary purpose of insurance in commercial business activities is to ______.
options: Minimize or cover the risk of financial loss
questions.answer: Minimize or cover the risk of financial loss
